notes.title: January 7th Update
notes.content:
1. The list of 'Thanks of wall' has been updated to January 6th.
2. Bug fixes have been implemented.

notes.title: September 9th Update
notes.content:
The wall of thanks list has been updated to September 9th.
Note: Besides adding wishlist + follow users, purchase + follow users can also be on the wall. Names should not contain special characters or other sensitive content.

notes.title: July 30 update
notes.content:
1. Fixed individual timeline bugs.
2. The wall of thanks list has been updated to July 29th.
Note: Besides adding wishlist + follow users, purchase + follow users can also be on the wall. Names should not contain special characters or other sensitive content.

notes.title: May 29th update
notes.content:
1. Fixed the bug where adjusting the volume was ineffective.
2. Optimized the text.
3. The account name is temporarily out of use.

notes.title: Updated on May 26t
notes.content:
- Optimize the text.
- Update the wall of appreciation to include names up until May 24th, meaning users who have been added to the wall on or before May 24th.
Note: In addition to users who have added their wishlists and followed, users who have purchased and followed can also be featured on the wall. Please ensure names do not contain special characters or other sensitive content.

notes.title: May 24th update
notes.content:
- Optimized some text
- Fixed the crash bug

notes.title: Update on May 23.
notes.content:
- Optimized text
- Fixed known bugs
- Updated the wall of thanks list to May 20th, which means users from May 20th and before have been added to the wall.
Note: In addition to users who add to the wishlist + follow, users who purchase + follow can also be added to the wall. Names should not contain special characters or other sensitive content.

notes.title: Update on May 20th
notes.content:
- Corrected typos in the text
- Fixed known bugs
- Updated the wall of thanks list to May 18th, meaning users from May 18th and before have been added to the wall.
Note: In addition to users who add to their wishlist + follow, users who purchase + follow can also be added to the wall. It is best if names do not contain special characters or other sensitive content.

notes.title: Correct spelling mistakes and update the wall of thanks.
notes.content:
Update on May 18th:
- Corrected typos in the text
- Updated the wall of thanks to include users up to May 16th, i.e., users who have been added on or before May 16th are now on the wall.
Note: In addition to users who add to the wishlist and follow, users who make a purchase and follow can also be featured on the wall. It is best if names do not contain special characters or other sensitive content.

notes.title: CaseCracker2 Demo Version Update
notes.content:
Update Details:
- Added case details.
- Optimized some features and the user interface.
- Archives can be carried over to the official version.
- Support for Mac systems.
- English language support added.

Please note that this update will overwrite the progress of the old demo version.

notes.title: CaseCracker 2 demo has been released.
notes.content:
1. The demo version includes the first case of the game.
2. The content of the demo version is almost identical to that of the playtest version, so there's no need to play it twice.
